alphafold-3: A scientifically inspired macro scene: one expressive folded protein ribbon interacting with a clearly distinct double-stranded DNA fragment and a small molecular ligand represented by a restrained ball-and-stick cluster. Cerulean blue protein, coral DNA, amber ligand against a clean white laboratory-style background. Detailed molecular forms, elegant depth, the complete structure visible. Conceptual molecular artwork, not an experimental result or a literal atomic structure.
gpt-4o: A premium editorial composition connecting three sensory channels: a real-looking microphone, a small camera lens, and a page with abstract unlettered lines. Three different clean material textures connected through a central translucent geometric junction. Cobalt, mint, and coral with white negative space. A visual metaphor for text, vision, and audio, no branded devices or interface screenshots.
apple-intelligence: Close-up editorial still life of an unbranded smartphone beside a small protective translucent enclosure holding personal notes and a key. A second distant computing block outside the enclosure, linked by a narrow carefully gated path. Soft silver, emerald, and warm pink accents. The metaphor is personal context and device/cloud privacy, not an actual Apple device, logo, or UI.
crowdstrike-outage: An editorial macro composition of precision mechanical switch tiles arranged as a network. One small red tile has fallen out of alignment and interrupted several clean paths, while a separate green recovery path remains intact. Industrial photography-inspired texture, bright neutral background, graphite, red and turquoise. A sober metaphor for an update cascading into a software outage, no fake blue-screen messages.
eu-ai-act: A premium conceptual still life of a modern transparent balance scale, a small computing chip on one side and a stack of plain document sheets on the other. Three distinct colored severity markers at the base: pale green, amber, and red. Crisp daylight, ivory-free white and graphite surfaces, teal accent. A visual metaphor for risk-based AI governance, not a legal diagram, no flags or logos.
deepseek-r1: A beautifully detailed cutaway maze made of dark ceramic channels with one continuous cyan route and several muted alternative routes, leading from a simple input block to a clear output block. Wide overhead perspective, complete maze visible, sharp edges, white background, blue and tangerine accents. Editorial metaphor for reasoning and verification, no logos, no brain or glowing particles.
economic-index: A contemporary editorial illustration of a human hand and a simple robotic gripper each moving different work tiles across a shared desk. Some tiles remain with the person and some move along a parallel automation track. Restrained realistic materials, forest green, cobalt and warm yellow accents on white. Show collaboration and task-level evidence, not job-loss statistics or a factual chart.
copilot-agent: An elegant isometric editorial scene of a small autonomous delivery rover moving a neatly packaged code-like block toward a transparent inspection gate operated by a human hand. Three modest testing checkpoints before the gate; the package has only abstract marks, not code text. Crisp navy, mint and orange, bright paper-like background. Metaphor for issue-to-pull-request delegation with human review, no GitHub trademark.
google-ai-mode: A premium editorial visualization of a large optical lens exploring a branching network of several individual document pages. Distinct pages remain visible around a central conversational speech form, connected by thin precise paths. Fresh cobalt, coral and green accents on white. A visual metaphor for conversational search and source links, not an actual Google interface, no readable letters or logos.
windows-10: An editorial product-photo-inspired scene of a generic open laptop beside a disconnected old protective shield and a newly attached clean protective shield. A measured stepping-stone path leads from the old setup to the supported one. Cool silver, graphite, blue and green accents, crisp natural studio lighting. Support lifecycle metaphor, no Windows logo, no fake warning text, no branded computer.
anthropic-defense: A sober editorial still life of a computing module separated from an institutional doorway by a deliberate transparent boundary gate. A human hand holds a small physical permission key outside the boundary. Graphite, muted blue and a restrained red accent on white. Metaphor for public procurement and AI usage boundaries, not a photograph of officials, no weapons, portraits, national symbols, or logos.
ai-jobs: A thoughtful editorial scene with three everyday workstations: a keyboard, a document tray, and a small drafting tool. Colored transparent overlays cover only parts of each workstation while the remaining tools remain clearly visible. Cyan, green and orange overlays, clean natural lighting and white background. Visual metaphor for partial task exposure rather than entire jobs disappearing, no made-up charts, numbers, or labels.
ai-pacing: An elegant editorial composition of a precise ascending computing staircase interrupted by a clearly designed safety checkpoint. One green inspection arm carefully checks the next step before the path continues. Dynamic diagonal framing with the whole checkpoint visible, graphite, pale blue and strong green against white. Metaphor for pacing frontier AI and checking safeguards, not a claim that development has stopped. No CEO portraits, logos, clocks with readable numbers, or fake documents.
